title: Turned away at the Comedy Club in Harlem
summary: Asked how he began to tap, he says dancers at the Comedy Club basement did not think him good enough and routed him out; he sets it apart from the Hoofers Club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When was the first time that you started tap-dancing?
Can you tell me about that?
You don't have to get us down there. You can just start talking about when you really started tap dancing, what influenced you initially, why did you decide to start tap dancing.
Right. Can you tell me a little bit more about that?

I told you that my voice cracked at the Audubon Theater, I thought I should do another talent instead of the one I am losing. That's when I think I'm losing my voice. You understand? That's how I decided to do another talent, to dance. That's what interested me in dancing, my voice cracking, you see? Then I started dancing -- okay? Then they had a player club uptown called the Comedy Club where all the fellas used to hang out, entertainers used to hang out in this club and meet at this club, waiting for bookings or places to work or play.

That's where they'd meet to hang out and they had a little dancing session down there that goes on. People learn how to dance and everything down there, you know. So you can come down there and practice or rehearse, if that's what you want to learn or steal what you want to steal -- one of those things, you know. So I went to this club to see what was happening and they didn't want me to dance, I started dancing, and they didn't think I was good enough. So they routed me out. So then I went to California.
This club was up in Harlem?
Was this also called the Hoofers's Club?
Comedy Club. What was the Hoofers's Club -- I'm trying to think what the Hoofers's Club was.
It sounds very similar. There's a pool hall in the front.
In the back room was a dancing hall. They'd let dancers go there --
No, this was downstairs in the basement. It don't make no difference. Either one is the same, Hoofers Club or the Comedy Club.
